1.en_consolidated_definition:
Plumber's apprentice or plumber. A person specializing in the installation and maintenance of water and other fluid conduits. Usual. 

Note: The term "plomero" is a common occupation in Puerto Rico and Latin America, equivalent to a plumber.

Also, for context, "Cantera" refers to a neighborhood or district in San Juan, Puerto Rico, but it's not directly relevant to the definition of a plumber.

The phrase "hijo de una prostituta y de un plomero de Cantera" is a colloquial expression that roughly translates to "illegitimate child of a prostitute and a plumber from Cantera". This part of the sentence provides background information on the person's parentage but is not essential to understanding the definition of a plumber.

The phrase "Su madre murió de sífilis cuando tenía un año y fue el plomero quien lo crió" translates to "His mother died of syphilis when he was one year old, and it was the plumber who raised him". This part of the sentence provides additional context on the person's upbringing but is not directly related to the definition of a plumber.
